teaching.en: I am writing about flight J72 on 18 November. It was scheduled for 13:15 but departed at 14:40. Because of this delay, I missed the 15:10 airport bus and paid €17 for a taxi. My request is proportionate to the direct impact, and I am not asking for any benefit that these facts do not support.
